serial_note: Serials are written as the DAT writes them, and the DAT uses both forms: 'SLES-01971' and 'SLPS 02251' in the PlayStation DAT of the same day. A core reads the serial from the disc in its own spelling (SYSTEM.CNF holds 'SLPS_022.51', DuckStation reports 'SLPS-02251'). No source fixes a rule joining the two, so the comparison rule is the reader's to state.
